phase_boundary_contract: real dispatcher boundaries: block decode/build and instruction-boundary admission; minimum-key sizing, TranslationKey/snapshot work and cache lookup; typed IR lowering; allocator build; ARM64 emission plus byte encoding/finalization; backend publication; host executor call. A cache hit still records block build and key/lookup. Every phase is sequential and non-overlapping. Each observed phase duration spans the Instant sample in PhaseRecorder::begin through the clock read in PhaseRecorder::end, so it includes the wrapped operation and wrapper/callback transit between those samples.
phase_overhead_interpretation: ordinary/observed paired ratios measure total instrumentation overhead on identical cold sweeps. Phase durations include the operation and elapsed boundary transit between the begin/end clock samples; PhaseRecorder bookkeeping after the end clock read is excluded from that phase. other_dispatch_ns is measured dispatch total minus phase totals and includes control guards, cache install/accounting, result validation, and observer work outside measured phase intervals. Components are attribution within one observed pass, not independent end-to-end measurements and must not be summed with other benchmark reports.
timing_scope: dispatch-call intervals across a complete S3-17 corpus sweep; each sweep constructs a fresh FIFO16 runtime/cache/arena; per-case state cloning and interpreter-result validation are outside each dispatch-call interval; arena teardown is outside intervals
